scientific_objective: After SW0 failed the frozen real predictive evaluation, test a low-freedom replacement family entirely in synthetic worlds, explicitly adding probability-calibration objectives so synthetic selection is better aligned with the observed SW0 failure mode. No protected real outcome is used for candidate fitting, scoring or selection.

candidate_families.degrees_of_freedom: small finite global temperature set frozen before scoring
candidate_families.purpose: preserve score ranking while reducing probability over-sharpness

candidate_families.input_family: synthetic score plus within-race score rank
candidate_families.degrees_of_freedom: small finite blend-weight set frozen before scoring
candidate_families.purpose: reduce sensitivity to score-scale drift while preserving ordinal information

candidate_families.degrees_of_freedom: bounded finite flattening family frozen before scoring
candidate_families.purpose: reduce catastrophic ordered-top3 NLL while retaining useful ranking

synthetic_evaluation_design.seed_policy: use multiple seeds not used for candidate construction; freeze exact seed list before execution
synthetic_evaluation_design.selection_unit: world x field-size x seed cells plus pooled summary

eligibility_gates.exact_aggregate_rule_to_freeze_before_ex: lexicographic: reject any numerical-sanity/worst-cell failure; then minimize pooled ordered-top3 NLL; tie-break by pooled winner log loss, then pooled winner Brier, then simplicity/candidate-id order

anti_overfit_rules: No Gate #487 protected outcome may be reopened, rescored or queried during synthetic selection.
No candidate coefficient or family may be changed in response to Gate #487 per-race or subgroup outcomes.
No DEV2000 C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 access.
No real PRE fitting, calibration, model selection or promotion.
If the frozen synthetic family fails, record NO_SYNTHETICALLY_ELIGIBLE_REPLACEMENT rather than widening the search post hoc.
Any later protected real-result evaluation requires a new preregistration and a new exact Owner Gate.
